name: BRAND TEXT
description:
A Cedrus Sauna produces five to thirty times the infrared of any other sauna on the market. Not only do we produce more of this safe, healing light, we do it at a better wavelength. This allows your body to absorb more far infrared in less time and at a lower temperature than any other infrared sauna. This is made possible by our patented heater design found only in Sauna built by Full Spectrum International Inc.



Only a Cedrus Sauna is covered by a lifetime warranty giving you the peace of mind of knowing the investment in your health and well being is protected 100%... as long as you own the sauna. Again, only found in a sauna built by Full Spectrum International Inc.



These reasons alone would be enough to choose a Cedrus Sauna... but we didn't stop there. Every Cedrus Sauna is hand crafted out of beautiful Canadian Red Cedar and plugs in to normal house hold 120 volt current. The attention to detail and your needs is obvious at first viewing. Our patented hidden latch system allows assembly in minutes, without tools, yet looks like a fine piece of furniture you'll be proud to display anywhere inside or out. Our wireless remote control gives easy access to all functions while our upgraded stereo system helps relax and sooth your body and your soul.
